examples.english: And Booz said, In the day of thy buying the field of the hand of Noemin and of Ruth the Moabitess the wife of the deceased, thou must also buy her, so as to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.
The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

examples.english: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
